lemmas.primary_translation: a mixture of a little of everything

definitions.translation: a mixture of a little of everything (lit. mixed candies)

examples.no: det er blanda drops, litt pop, litt rock og mye annet
examples.en: it is a mixed bag: a little pop, a little rock, and much else

examples.no: publikum i kveld er ganske så blanda drops
examples.en: the audience tonight is quite a mixed bag
